newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal PSBR fell 30 pct yr/yr Jan-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Portugal PSBR fell 30 pct yr/yr Jan-Oct.

text.p: Portugal's public sector borrowing fell 30.5 percent year-on-year in the first 10 months of the year to 436.2 billion escudos, the Bank of Portugal said in its latest monthly report.
In October, the public sector had a net inflow of 100.6 billion escudos due to privatisation income.
The government has forecast the budget deficit will fall to 4.0 percent of gross domestic product in 1996 from 4.9 percent the previous year.
